_comment: The SAS environments for the hackathon: one Viya + one RAM per environment. Teams are spread over them in order (team 1 -> 1, team 2 -> 2, ..., team 7 -> 1 again). Add a row when a new environment is ready. The sign-in names and passwords shown on the home page come from VIYA_USER, VIYA_PASSWORD, RAM_USER and RAM_PASSWORD on the server, never from this file.
